title: dvload mapping (.dvmap.json)
description: Column mapping from an Excel/CSV source table to a Dataverse entity set. Mirrors parseMapping + validateMapping in packages/core/src/mapping.ts, which remain the enforcement point — this file exists for editor completion and CI linting. Keep both in sync and bump schemaVersion together; `node tests/schema-parity.mjs` checks that they agree.
x-not-enforceable: Every upsertKey entry must also appear as a columns[].target. JSON Schema draft-07 cannot reference sibling array contents.
columns[].target must be unique across the array. uniqueItems compares whole items, not one property.

schemaVersion.description: Must equal SCHEMA_VERSION. parseMapping rejects any other value outright rather than attempting a migration.

name.description: Human-readable mapping name. Used in the run summary, the webhook notification, and as the default scheduled-task name.

description.description: Free text shown in the CLI and add-in.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC. Written by the add-in; preserved on round-trip via state.mappingExtras.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC. Rewritten by serializeMapping on every save.

environmentUrl.description: Dataverse base URL, e.g. https://contoso.crm.dynamics.com. Also determines the token scope (<origin>/.default) and which stored credentials are used.

targetEntitySet.description: Plural entity set name, e.g. contacts. Must satisfy assertLogicalName (^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$) at run time — it is interpolated into request URLs.

sourceTable.description: Excel table (ListObject) name, typically a Power Query output. Ignored for .csv/.tsv sources. Also the query name used when injecting into a .pqt.

sourceSheet.description: Constrain the table search to one worksheet. Omit to search the whole workbook.

columns.description: Column mappings, applied in order. Target attributes must be unique across the array.

conflictMode.description: insert = POST creates. upsert = PATCH by key (creates or updates). skip-if-exists = PATCH with If-None-Match:* (create only; 412 counts as skipped). sync = upsert, then deactivate or delete target records whose key is absent from the source.

upsertKey.description: Required for upsert, sync, and skip-if-exists. Either the attributes forming a Dataverse alternate key, or a single uniqueidentifier column holding the record's own primary id. Every entry must also appear as a column target.

batchSize.description: Rows per $batch request. Dataverse hard-caps at 1000. Each row becomes its own changeset inside the batch.

maxErrors.description: Stop scheduling new batches once this many row errors have accumulated. 0 = unlimited. Unattempted rows are counted as skipped.

logDir.description: Run log, checkpoint, and failed-rows output directory, resolved relative to the mapping file (not the workbook).

concurrency.description: Parallel $batch requests. Raising this makes checkpoints frontier-based rather than sequential; see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.

bypassCustomLogic.description: Send MSCRM.BypassCustomPluginExecution and MSCRM.SuppressCallbackRegistrationExpanderJob on every operation. Requires the prvBypassCustomPlugins privilege.

impersonateUserId.description: systemuser GUID sent as MSCRMCallerID. Requires prvActOnBehalfOfAnotherUser.

skipUnchanged.description: upsert/sync only. Pre-read each target record and drop attributes that already match; skip the row entirely if nothing changed. Costs one GET per row; lookup binds are always sent.

syncAction.description: conflictMode=sync only. What to do with target records missing from the source. Defaults to deactivate, which filters candidates to statecode eq 0.

notifyUrl.description: Webhook receiving a {text: summary} POST after the run (Teams/Slack incoming-webhook compatible). Must be https, or http://localhost for testing, because a shared mapping file could otherwise exfiltrate run summaries.

then.description: validateMapping: conflictMode=upsert/sync requires at least one upsertKey attribute.
validateMapping: skipUnchanged requires conflictMode=upsert or sync.
validateMapping: syncAction only applies when conflictMode=sync.

source.description: Source column header, matched exactly as read from the table's header row. Mutually exclusive with constant.

constant.description: Fixed value applied to every record instead of reading a column. Coerced through the same pipeline as a cell value: for lookups this is a record GUID (guid resolution) or a key value (alternateKey/text). Mutually exclusive with source.

target.description: Dataverse attribute logical name. For lookups this is the writable single-valued navigation property, which is NOT always the attribute name (parentcustomerid -> parentcustomerid_account).

kind.description: Coercion target type. See docs/DATA-FORMATS.md for the exact per-kind rules.

bindEntitySet.description: lookup only: the entity set the bind points at, e.g. accounts.

lookupResolution.description: lookup only. guid = the cell already holds the record id. alternateKey = resolve via a Dataverse alternate key. text = resolve by exact match on any attribute via $filter.

keyAttribute.description: Required when lookupResolution is alternateKey or text: the attribute to match on.

createIfMissing.description: lookupResolution=text only: create a record in bindEntitySet with keyAttribute set to the source value when no match exists.

duplicateBehavior.description: lookupResolution=text only: what to do when the value matches 2+ records. error fails the row; first takes the first match.

optionMap.description: choice/multichoice/status/state: human label -> integer option value. The add-in fills this from option-set metadata. Cells may then contain either labels or raw integers.

treatEmptyAsNull.description: true: a blank cell sends null, clearing the field. false: the attribute is omitted from the payload entirely. For lookups, null is only sent when the operation can update an existing record.

format.description: datetime/dateonly only: an explicit parse format built from the tokens yyyy, MM, M, dd, d, HH, H, mm, ss (all other characters are literals). Pins ambiguous text dates instead of guessing.

notes.description: UI-only annotation. Ignored by the engine.

then.description: validateColumn: a lookup column needs both bindEntitySet and lookupResolution.

else.description: validateColumn: createIfMissing and duplicateBehavior only apply to lookup columns.

then.description: validateColumn: alternateKey and text resolution both need a keyAttribute.
validateColumn: createIfMissing and duplicateBehavior require lookupResolution=text.
